summary: Air-date lane only. Ep 10's stored 2018-03-17 is CORRECT; the regression is caused by ep 9, whose stored 2018-10-10 is a month-digit corruption of 2018-03-10. The show ran a clean weekly Saturday 23:30 MBS/TBS slot from 2018-01-13, so eps 8/9/10/11 = 03-03 / 03-10 / 03-17 / 03-24 with no gaps. One repair, no true deviation.

repairs.why: syoboi TID 4788 Count 9 = 2018-03-10 23:30 (the whole run is an unbroken weekly Saturday 23:30 sequence 2018-01-13 … 2018-07-07); en-WP List of Darling in the Franxx episodes: ep 9 'Triangle Bomb' = 2018-03-10, cited to the official site darli-fra.jp/story/?no=9. 2018-10-10 is three months after the series ended.

structure.notes: 24 rows, 1:1 with ja-WP 第N話 / en-WP EpisodeNumber. No specials or recaps in the row space.

flags_for_sean: Ep 10 (The City of Eternity) needs no repair: 2018-03-17 is confirmed by syoboi and en-WP. ja-WP's 各話リスト for this series carries no 放送日 column, so syoboi + en-WP (which cites the official darli-fra.jp story pages) are the two sources.
